entities.name: Query ABC transporter
observations: 768 aa membrane protein with two ABC membrane-related Pfam regions (MTABC_N, ABC_membrane) and a C-terminal ABC nucleotide-binding domain (ABC_tran).
Sequence-derived molecular weight is approximately 87.3 kDa; predicted pI is 8.59.
Contains the ABC Walker A/P-loop motif in the C-terminal nucleotide-binding domain: LALVGPSGSGKST.
Homologous to reviewed ABCB6 proteins with approximately 51–55% identity and up to 99.5% query coverage; evidence grade is moderate homology support.

entities.name: ABCB6
observations: ABCB6 is a eukaryotic ATP-dependent ABC transporter associated with porphyrin/heme transport.
Reviewed homolog annotations assign EC 7.6.2.5 and ABC-type heme transporter activity.

Reported as a homodimer and localized to multiple intracellular membranes, including mitochondrial outer membrane, endosomes, lysosomes, Golgi, ER, plasma membrane, and melanosomes, depending on organism and context.

entities.name: Porphyrin export coupled to ATP hydrolysis
observations: Candidate stoichiometry for ABCB6-like transport is porphyrin(in) + ATP + H2O = porphyrin(out) + ADP + phosphate + H(+).
Retrieved substrate candidates include heme b, protoporphyrin IX, coproporphyrin III, coproporphyrinogen III, and pheophorbide a; exact substrate specificity is not established from sequence alone.
